defects.description: The safe-water share is given as 'almost three-quarters — around 64%', but three-quarters is 75%, not 64%.
paraphrases: Three-quarters is 75%, so 'around 64%' does not match.
The word (three-quarters) and the figure (64%) disagree.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'around 74%' (~three-quarters). Findable from the fraction and the figure in the same sentence, distinct.

defects.description: The share without safe water is given as 'one in four, roughly 46%', but one in four is 25%, not 46%.
paraphrases: One in four is 25%, so 'roughly 46%' is wrong.
The fraction (one in four) and the percentage (46%) disagree.
46% is far more than a quarter.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'roughly 25%' (one in four; complement of ~75%). Findable from the fraction, distinct.

defects.description: The gap between >50 and <0.05 per 100,000 is called 'more than a millionfold', but 50 / 0.05 is about 1,000 — a thousandfold, not a millionfold.
paraphrases: 50 divided by 0.05 is about 1,000, so it is a thousandfold, not a millionfold.
The stated fold-difference overstates the 50-vs-0.05 ratio by a thousand times.
A ratio of 50 to 0.05 is roughly 1,000-fold, not a million.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'thousandfold' (50/0.05 = 1000). Findable from the two death-rate figures, distinct.
